claims.title: Shared-service microdevices: passive contacts and conditional installed tests

quoted_fields.interface: 56-component,136-terminal-join,43-net optical head with32 qualifying submillimetre passives, proposed23.4x23.4x23.2mm envelope, paid external instrument and three useful geometric arrangements. Shared tooling must capture the leaf, independently own seven component loads before cap removal, positively own/open one target, test it isolated, restore receiver stock and qualify assembled function after every tool withdraws. Conditional electrical bounds require the stated installed error and unintended-path topology.
quoted_fields.failure: Shared service reduces replicated active mechanisms but passive contact/routing/retention burden still scales with terminals. The root-loop certificate is conditional; hidden same-terminal shunts and probe deformation can defeat it. Neither sampled route envelopes nor a scheduled jam branch are complete physical motions. Producer reported temperature/network results do not qualify contact wear, alloy wetting, actual heat boundaries or life. Full manufacturing speed/cost/physical-yield targets remain unachieved. ROOT passive-bound assumptions exclude hotter/powered internal stocks; no installed detector or actual isolating gap is furnished.
